metadata.sysdescription: Brightfall has 4 seperate govenments each consiting of two Civil class stations and an industrial facility. unforunetlyt the govenments do not get along with each other and disputes are frequent between them. The single jump point means that a lot of trade simply bypasses the system. Piracy is rife in Brightfall due to the conflicted nature of the area. blockades of the jump point are not unheard of.
